title: West Pikeland calls an Oct. 26 special meeting to rethink the SALT building sale
summary: A week after voting 3-2 to put the township-owned cultural center at 1645 Art School Rd. up for sale, supervisors will meet again Monday, Oct. 26 at 7 p.m. to discuss options for the property. SALT Performing Arts, which has put about $400,000 into the building, holds a license that a buyer could end on 30 days' notice.

title: Square Roots Collective buys Kennett Square's 1903 trolley barn
summary: The nonprofit behind The Creamery, Artelo and Opus paid $2.3 million for the Brewers Row building at 225-229 Birch St., home to Braeloch Brewing and Chaikhana Chai. The group has not said what it plans for the property, which sits between its existing projects.

title: A readers' retreat built around West Chester's bookstores is set for Nov. 20-22
summary: Novelist JB Harris is bringing the first Future Famous Authors Bookish Retreat to the borough, with visits to Baldwin's Book Barn, Bookmarks and Leaves and Lore, an author panel dinner and rooms at the Book House Hotel and Hotel Indigo. It is aimed at readers, not aspiring writers.

title: Rain-soaked Great Pumpkin Carve still lit 85 giant pumpkins in Chadds Ford
summary: Friday's washout cancelled a night of the Chadds Ford Historical Society's sole fundraiser, but carvers still finished 85 pumpkins of about 250 pounds each for the lit display behind the visitor center. The tradition began with the Wyeths at the Chadds Ford Inn in the early 1970s.
loc: Chadds Ford Historical Society, Chadds Ford

title: Chester County Hospital opens an outpatient lactation center
summary: Penn Medicine Chester County Hospital has opened a center where new parents can book one-on-one sessions with lactation consultants after they go home with their baby.

title: Andy Dinniman hands Chester County a trove of historic papers
summary: The retired state senator and former county commissioner presented decades of collected documents and artwork to the commissioners at their Oct. 21 meeting on West Market Street, and urged the county to keep investing in open space ahead of its 2027 budget.

title: Friends Association wins $250,000 for eviction prevention
summary: A state Community and Economic Assistance Program grant, announced by Rep. Chris Pielli, will fund the West Chester nonprofit's Eviction Prevention Case Resolution program, which offers free legal help, landlord mediation and rental assistance to households facing eviction.

title: Stove & Tap wins People's Choice at the rescheduled Chili Cook-Off
summary: Thousands turned out downtown on Oct. 18 for the weather-delayed F4 Chili Cook-Off, where Ryan's Pub took the restaurant title and about 800 pounds of leftover chili went to local nonprofits.

title: West Chester Refillery Station opens on East Street Road
summary: A refill shop selling household staples in bulk for customers' own containers has opened at 54 E. Street Rd., per the Inquirer's Chester County roundup.

title: Turks Head Wines adds a restaurant to its West Chester tasting room
summary: The California-focused winery at 120 N. Church St. began serving food this month and brought on chef Dave McDonald, formerly of Helm BYOB.
